name: Automated Multi-Channel Performance Reporting & Executive Digest
purpose: Aggregate live performance data across Google, Meta, and TikTok into verified, deterministic executive summaries, PDF/Markdown digests, and Telegram briefings.
triggerConditions: On-demand user request for performance report
prerequisites: Platform adapters connected with live read access
Client target CPA and ROAS goals configured
Reporting date range specified (e.g. Last 7 Days, Month-to-Date)

executionSteps.name: Query Validated Multi-Platform Metrics
executionSteps.action: Query Spend, Impressions, Clicks, Conversions, Revenue, CPA, and ROAS across all connected platform adapters

executionSteps.name: Calculate Blended Metrics & Attribution Comparison
executionSteps.action: Compute blended CAC, blended ROAS, platform contribution percentages, and cross-reference with GA4 source/medium

executionSteps.name: Generate Executive Insights & Trends
executionSteps.action: Identify top 3 winning campaigns, biggest efficiency gainers, and key channels for upcoming budget shift

executionSteps.name: Format Multi-Channel Deliverables
executionSteps.action: Render bilingual Telegram chat digest (Bangla/English) and generate comprehensive Markdown/PDF audit document

successCriteria: 100% of reported numbers sourced from official platform APIs (zero fabricated metrics)
Bilingual readability with actionable key takeaways
Report generation completes in under 15 seconds

failureHandling.retryStrategy: Retry metric fetch up to 2 times with 5s delay on rate limit

rollbackStrategy: Read-only operation; in the event of partial API failure, output report with explicit 'DATA_UNAVAILABLE' indicator for the failing channel.
